The warning is clear, and I don’t want a “keep both anyway” option—the same address should remain one bookmark.

“Show the one I already have” should open that bookmark for editing, not only highlight it. If I save it again, I probably want to update its title, description, tags, note, or address.

For deciding what is the same, treating the domain, `www.`, and a trailing slash as equivalent feels right. However, path capitalization can identify a genuinely different page on some sites, so I wouldn’t generally treat differently capitalized paths as the same. For this demonstration, please use a difference that is safely equivalent, such as only the domain capitalization or trailing slash.
